name: Cua huynh de
summary: A crab the provincial portal calls the king of crabs, from Tam Quan and Đề Gi. It is yellow, heavily spined, and scarce. Cổng thông tin điện tử tỉnh Bình Định puts the season at lunar month 12 through lunar month 3.
origin: Thị trấn Tam Quan, thị xã Hoài Nhơn. The prose also names Đề Gi, and waters at Tuy Phong and Sa Huỳnh.
howToEat: The portal gives three plates: salted and braised with rice, steamed with a salt of green chili, and a porridge of the meat. It says the steamed crab is the one that keeps the sweetness, and the roe is rich.
The season is lunar month 12 through lunar month 3. A shop hour was not printed. Check on arrival.
where: Tam Quan, Hoài Nhơn, and the Đề Gi coast. Not the Quy Nhon city beach.
seoTitle: Cua huynh de — the Tam Quan crab
seoDescription: Cua huỳnh đế is the scarce yellow crab of Tam Quan and Đề Gi, in lunar months 12 through 3. Braised, steamed, or in porridge. A price is Check on arrival.
